snippet.title: Heartbeat House — A Hong Kong Reality-Dating Visual Novel | 2-Minute Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into a real reality-dating show—
except this time, you are the main character.

Heartbeat House is a romance visual novel set in Hong Kong.
Every choice you make—every glance, every moment of silence—
can bring you closer to someone… or push you further apart.

In this 2-minute gameplay trailer, you’ll see:

💗 Selectable Male Route / Female Route
💗 Reality-show-style interactions
💗 3D-modeled Hong Kong environments
💗 Authentic urban atmosphere and details
💗 First appearances of multiple characters

Who you pursue—
and how this story unfolds—
is entirely up to you.

👉 Wishlist “Heartbeat House: Hong Kong” on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4131900/_/

👉 itch.io demo (mobile):
https://mplcwsc.itch.io/heartbeat-house-hongkong

📌 Follow for more updates:
IG: /heartbeathousehk
Facebook: /genuinestudiohk

If you enjoy romance games, visual novels, or interactive story experiences,
feel free to like the video, leave a comment, and don’t forget to subscribe!
